validity.recommendation: Not a duplicate of P4450 (Rogers City Connector) or P4451 (Norwalk Manistee Connector). All three share MPSC Case No. U-20894 (July 27, 2021 order) and the same DMLC applicant, but P4449 is the conversion of the EXISTING Wet Header gathering system to dry-gas transmission service, while P4450/P4451 are brand-new connector pipelines built to interconnect that converted system into existing transmission facilities. Because P4449 involves no new physical pipe, LengthKnown/Diameter are left unfilled per the conversion-project convention rather than treated as MISSING_VALUE gaps.
validity.researcher_notes: MPSC PFD, Case No. U-21525 (Oct 2, 2024), p.4: witness Richman testified 'the Wet Header System was originally designed as a gathering system to transport wet gas and in 2021, the Commission approved a certificate of necessity to convert portions of the system from gas gathering to dry gas transmission services, and to construct, operate, and maintain connector pipelines from the existing system to interconnect into existing transmission facilities.' The Manistee News Advocate (2021-07-29) separately itemizes three distinct cost components under the same MPSC order: 'a $28 million project' (the conversion, i.e. P4449), 'the $7 million Rogers City Connector' (P4450), and 'the $13.9 million Norwalk Manistee Connector' (P4451) - confirming three physically distinct facilities under one docket, not duplicate entries for one pipeline.
